subject.title: fix(doctor): surface multi-account default routing warnings in preview and lint

question: Should this PR make missing default-account routing a default warning-severity `openclaw doctor --lint` finding that exits nonzero for existing multi-account configs?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but the default lint exit behavior can affect existing operator workflows and CI gates even though no config is rewritten.

options.title: Accept default lint warning
options.body: Merge as-is and own the nonzero lint result as the intended compatibility tradeoff for ambiguous routing configs.

options.title: Preserve lint compatibility
options.body: Keep preview and `--fix` warnings, but make lint stricter behavior opt-in or lower severity until maintainers approve the default policy.

options.title: Hold for broader routing RFC
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the lint, dispatch-warning, setup, and hot-reload policy together in the related routing issue.

recommendation.title: Accept default lint warning
recommendation.body: Merge as-is and own the nonzero lint result as the intended compatibility tradeoff for ambiguous routing configs.
